title: Unemployment Benefit Claims — Certifying a Week by Phone, Including Weeks with Holiday Pay
content:
A claimant of Unemployment Benefit Claims may certify a benefit week on the phone line, answering the weekly questions personally. When a claimant certifies a week in which an employer paid holiday pay that the claimant cannot yet state in dollars, the holiday pay reported as other pay for that week is the figure the Department values for it, and the agent tells the claimant the amount to enter.

## Certification timing on this function

A week after the first week of a benefit year is certified only after the claim carries a waiting-week entry.

This is a state of the claim's payment history: whether a waiting-week entry stands on the claim when a week other than the first week of the benefit year is certified.

## Who certifies

The function is `certify_week_by_phone_ea18d1f2`, a claimant-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, giving the answers personally. On success the claim carries one weekly certification for that week, filed on that day through the phone line, with the answers, earnings, hours, work-search contacts and other pay entered, and the timeliness class given.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format or values |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | The claim reference number of the claimant's claim, read to the claimant by the agent from the claim lookup | Identifier |
| `week_ending_date` | The Saturday ending the week certified | YYYY-MM-DD, always a Saturday |
| `cert_timeliness` | The timeliness class of this certification | `timely`, `late_good_cause`, `late_no_good_cause` |
| `able_and_available` | The claimant's answer about the whole week | `true` (able and available for full-time work all week) or `false` |
| `work_refused` | The claimant's answer about offers of work | `true` (an offer of work was refused during the week) or `false` |
| `gross_earnings` | Gross earnings for work performed in the week as the claimant states them | USD, 2 decimal places |
| `hours_worked` | Hours worked in the week as the claimant states them | Decimal hours, 1 decimal place |
| `work_search_contacts` | The number of work-search contacts made in the week | Integer count |
| `other_pay_type` | The kind of other pay for the week | One of the values below |
| `other_pay_amount` | The amount of the other pay for the week as the agent tells the claimant to enter it | USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when none |

Values of `cert_timeliness`: `timely` when the certification is filed within the certification window after the week ended; `late_good_cause` when it is filed after the window with an approved late-certification request inside the good-cause limit; `late_no_good_cause` when it is filed after the window without such approval.

Values of `other_pay_type`: `none` when no other pay was received; `vacation_pay` when vacation pay was paid for the week; `holiday_pay` when holiday pay was paid for a holiday in the week; `severance_pay` when severance or dismissal pay was received; `pension_employer_funded` when a pension wholly paid for by a base-period employer was received; `pension_claimant_contributed` when a pension the claimant paid into was received.

## Return

A successful run returns `certification_id` (the reference number of the certification), `claim_id`, `week_ending_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `certified_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the day of the run) and `cert_channel` (`phone_line`). Receiving `certification_id` means the week is certified.
